UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with authentication details, roles (Admin or User), gaming statistics, hardware, and activity stream.

displayName.description: Full display name of the user.

lastActive.description: Last active timestamp or login date/time.

blockCount.description: Number of times user has been blocked. Reaching 3 blocks triggers auto-blacklist.

liked.description: List of liked games and resources.

favorites.description: List of favorited games and resources.

library.description: User game library with status (Playing, Plan to Play, Completed, On Hold, Dropped).

gameHistory.description: Recently viewed or played game history records.

activities.description: Real-time user actions, telemetry, and live movement history.

pcSpecs.description: User PC hardware configuration specs (GPU, CPU, RAM, OS).

GlobalSettings.title: GlobalSettings
GlobalSettings.description: Global application configuration including the universal profile banner URL managed by Admin.

globalBannerURL.description: Global default profile banner URL set by Admin, applies to all users.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last global settings update.

updatedBy.description: Admin email that updated the setting.

SystemAdminProfile.title: SystemAdminProfile
SystemAdminProfile.description: Public system admin profile displayed on detail page badges and admin popup.

UserRequest.title: UserRequest
UserRequest.description: Item request submitted by a user.

/system/{docId}.description: Public system documents such as admin_profile and banner. Publicly readable, admin writable.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual user profile and telemetry. Readable and writable by the user or by Admin.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores system settings such as global profile banner. Readable publicly, writable by Admin only.

/requests/{requestId}.description: Stores item requests submitted by users.

/bannedDevices/{deviceId}.description: Stores banned hardware fingerprints and IPs. Non-public; accessible to admin or validated caller checking status, writable by Admin.
